query:
SELECT id, shareCode, reportType, 
  JSON_LENGTH(reportData, '$.comparables') as comp_count,
  JSON_LENGTH(reportData) as total_keys,
  JSON_KEYS(reportData) as top_keys,
  LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables')) as comps_data_size
FROM universal_shareable_reports 
WHERE reportType = 'validator' 
ORDER BY id DESC 
LIMIT 5;
